skill.name: brand-guidelines

content.value_statement: Brand styling can be inconsistent across slides, documents, and visual drafts. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code clear color and typography rules for Anthropic-style artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Lists main and accent color values for Anthropic-style visual work.
Defines heading and body font choices with fallback fonts.
Guides smart font application for headings, body text, and hierarchy.
Recommends accent color use for shapes and non-text elements.
Explains RGB color handling for PowerPoint-oriented workflows.
limitations: It provides styling guidance, not a complete design system.
Custom fonts must already exist in the user environment.
It does not confirm legal approval for brand usage.
It does not include executable automation scripts.

use_cases.title: Style a Slide Deck
use_cases.description: Apply consistent colors, fonts, and accent choices to presentation content.

use_cases.title: Review Marketing Drafts
use_cases.description: Check visual drafts for color, type, and hierarchy alignment before review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Briefs
use_cases.description: Format briefs and product visuals with a consistent Anthropic-style presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Style a Simple Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one document or slide.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the brand styling rules to this draft. Use the defined color palette, heading fonts, body fonts, and accent colors.

prompt_templates.title: Review Visual Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before sharing a design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this content for brand consistency. Identify color, typography, hierarchy, and accent usage issues with clear fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Styling Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a concise checklist for applying these brand guidelines across slides, documents, and visual assets.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Presentation System
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this presentation system against the brand guidelines. Prioritize color fidelity, typography rules, accessibility, and reusable layout guidance.

output_examples.input: A product update slide needs a cleaner Anthropic-style visual direction.
output_examples.output: Use a light background, dark primary text, Poppins-style headings, Lora-style body text, and one restrained orange accent.

output_examples.input: A report uses mixed fonts and several unrelated accent colors.
output_examples.output: Standardize headings and body text first. Then replace unrelated accents with the defined orange, blue, or green palette.

output_examples.input: A team wants a repeatable brand review checklist.
output: Confirm main background and text colors match the palette.
Check headings, body text, and hierarchy for consistent font use.
Limit accent colors to purposeful shape and highlight usage.

best_practices: Start with typography and hierarchy before adding accent colors.
Use accent colors sparingly so visual emphasis remains clear.
Confirm custom fonts are installed before final export.
anti_patterns: Do not mix unrelated brand palettes into the same artifact.
Do not rely on custom fonts without checking fallbacks.
Do not use accent colors as large background fills without review.

faq.question: What does this skill help style?
faq.answer: It helps style slides, documents, and visual artifacts using the included color and typography guidance.

faq.question: Does it install fonts?
faq.answer: No. It uses installed fonts when available and recommends Arial or Georgia fallbacks.

faq.question: Can it generate a complete brand manual?
faq.answer: No. It provides practical guidance for applying the included rules to artifacts.

faq.question: Does it run scripts or external tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill file contains guidance only and no executable automation.

faq.question: Can it support PowerPoint styling?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents RGB color use that can guide PowerPoint-oriented workflows.

faq.question: Is this suitable for public brand use?
faq.answer: Users should confirm brand and trademark approval before publishing external materials.
